resolvedStack: Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Prisma + NextAuth + Stripe
name: VaultAudit Compliance SaaS
description: VaultAudit Compliance SaaS helps security teams automate SOC 2 and ISO 27001 readiness checks, track evidence artifacts, and manage compliance audits with role-based access control, Stripe billing, and Prisma PostgreSQL.

metadata.name: VaultAudit Compliance SaaS
metadata.description: Automated SOC 2 / ISO 27001 compliance checks, policy controls, and audit reporting SaaS.

files.description: Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma 5, NextAuth v4, stripe, zod, react-hook-form, lucide-react.
PostgreSQL Prisma schema with Role, ComplianceStatus, Severity enums and User, ControlCheck, EvidenceItem, AuditReport models.
Shared TypeScript interfaces for ControlCheck, EvidenceItem, AuditReport.
Root layout with SessionProvider, Navbar, and Footer.
Edge middleware protecting /dashboard and /audits while keeping /, /pricing, /login, /register, /api/auth public.
Public landing page for VaultAudit Compliance SaaS.
Compliance readiness score dashboard with control check breakdown and recent evidence.
Compliance controls checklist with status updates and evidence upload form.
Register page posting to /api/register then signing in.
Client hook fetching /api/controls with safe default array.
GET and POST API route for ControlCheck records with Zod and Prisma.
GET and POST API route for AuditReport records.
